title: BsruAutoShutdown
description: Automatically and safely shuts down empty Minecraft servers to save resources. Perfect for network environments with On-Demand startup systems.
body:
# BsruAutoShutdown

**BsruAutoShutdown** is a high-performance, lightweight Minecraft plugin designed to optimize server resources by automatically shutting down sub-servers when no players are active. Perfect for network environments (BungeeCord/Velocity) using an On-Demand startup system.

## 🚀 Features

- **Automated Shutdown:** Monitor player counts and shut down the server after a configurable idle period.
- **Data Integrity:** Automatically executes `/save-all` before shutting down to prevent world corruption.
- **Highly Configurable:** Customize countdown timers and broadcast messages with full color code support.
- **Lightweight:** Minimal impact on server performance.
- **Professional Credits:** Proudly developed by **nattapat2871**.

## 🛠️ Commands

- `/bsruautoshutdown`: Displays plugin information and credits.
- `/bsruautoshutdown reload`: Reloads the configuration file without restarting the server.

## 🔑 Permissions

- `bsruautoshutdown.use`: Allows access to the base command info.
- `bsruautoshutdown.admin`: Allows reloading the configuration.

## 📂 Configuration

```yaml
# BsruAutoShutdown Config
# Author: nattapat2871

# Time in minutes to wait after the last player leaves before shutting down.
shutdown_delay_minutes: 10

messages:
  server_empty: "&7[BsruAutoShutdown] Server is empty. Countdown started: %minutes% minutes."
  shutting_down: "&c[BsruAutoShutdown] Server has been empty for 10 minutes. Performing safe shutdown..."
```

## 🏗️ Installation

1. Download the latest `.jar` from the [Releases](https://github.com/nattapat2871/BsruAutoShutdown/releases) page.
2. Place the jar into your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Restart your server.
4. Configure the settings in `plugins/BsruAutoShutdown/config.yml`.
